environment: Isolated Electron renderer; Chinese settings; native window sizing and zoom
limitations: Synthetic in-memory Quick Action data proves rendering, not API parsing.
Focus and center hit tests do not establish physical-device touch behavior.
Shortcut bindings are inspected without recording or changing them.
The 12-option draft is prepared using local Add option clicks, including DOM clicks when that control moves outside the viewport. This setup does not claim the add gesture is reachable.
